result.instructions: Tools for Modern Treasury, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Modern Treasury data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run modern_treasury_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run modern_treasury_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run modern_treasury_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. modern_treasury_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.
